WITH totals AS (
  SELECT i.id AS invoice_id, i.customer_id, SUM(l.amount_cents) AS total_cents
  FROM invoices i
  JOIN invoice_lines l ON l.invoice_id = i.id
  WHERE i.status = 'issued' AND i.issued_on <= '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY i.id, i.customer_id
),
alloc AS (
  SELECT pa.invoice_id, SUM(pa.amount_cents) AS cents
  FROM payment_allocations pa
  JOIN payments p ON p.id = pa.payment_id AND p.status = 'succeeded'
  WHERE pa.allocated_on <= '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY pa.invoice_id
),
cred AS (
  SELECT ca.invoice_id, SUM(ca.amount_cents) AS cents
  FROM credit_applications ca
  WHERE ca.applied_on <= '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY ca.invoice_id
)
SELECT b.customer_id, SUM(b.balance_cents) AS balance_cents
FROM (
  SELECT t.customer_id,
         t.total_cents - COALESCE(a.cents, 0) - COALESCE(c.cents, 0) AS balance_cents
  FROM totals t
  LEFT JOIN alloc a ON a.invoice_id = t.invoice_id
  LEFT JOIN cred c ON c.invoice_id = t.invoice_id
) b
GROUP BY b.customer_id
HAVING SUM(b.balance_cents) > 0
ORDER BY balance_cents DESC, b.customer_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT i.id AS invoice_id, SUM(l.amount_cents) AS total_cents
  FROM invoices i
  JOIN invoice_lines l ON l.invoice_id = i.id
  WHERE i.status = 'issued' AND i.issued_on <= '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY i.id
),
alloc AS (
  SELECT pa.invoice_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pa.allocated_on <= '2026-03-31' THEN pa.amount_cents ELSE 0 END) AS by_0331,
         SUM(pa.amount_cents) AS by_0430
  FROM payment_allocations pa
  JOIN payments p ON p.id = pa.payment_id AND p.status = 'succeeded'
  WHERE pa.allocated_on <= '2026-04-30'
  GROUP BY pa.invoice_id
),
cred AS (
  SELECT ca.invoice_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ca.applied_on <= '2026-03-31' THEN ca.amount_cents ELSE 0 END) AS by_0331,
         SUM(ca.amount_cents) AS by_0430
  FROM credit_applications ca
  WHERE ca.applied_on <= '2026-04-30'
  GROUP BY ca.invoice_id
)
SELECT t.invoice_id
FROM totals t
LEFT JOIN alloc a ON a.invoice_id = t.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN cred c ON c.invoice_id = t.invoice_id
WHERE t.total_cents - COALESCE(a.by_0331, 0) - COALESCE(c.by_0331, 0) > 0
  AND t.total_cents - COALESCE(a.by_0430, 0) - COALESCE(c.by_0430, 0) = 0
ORDER BY t.invoice_id;
